text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Trainer. This year,
we're finally
in the Classics...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
But what's with this room?! It's the
holiday season,
yet it looks so bleak in
here.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: That's precisely the point, you dummy!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Good grief! Just wait here a moment!

text_block_list.name: King Halo's Followers
text_block_list.text:
King, are these window decorations
okay?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they're perfect! You all sure do
know how to
please! ♪

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Give them more praise! ♪ They are my companions, after all!
choice_data_list: So this is the craft of a master...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh! It looks like the New Year's meal I
ordered
has arrived! All right, everyone,
wait right here!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! No, we should be thanking you!
We're just
happy we're able to spend
New Year's again with
King this year.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, we don't go home for the
holidays.
choice_data_list: Are you two always together over New Year's, too?
Are you two always together over New Year's, too?

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I don't get along with my parents so
well. When I
first came here, I just holed
up in my room during
the holidays.

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: But then I met King...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! A little bird told me that
there's a pair
of younger students having
the most dreadfully
boring New Year's
gathering!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Who are you?! And what are you doing
barging
into our room?! You older
students think you just
run everything,
don't you?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"Older student" barely befits me. You
will refer to
me as King Halo, the
first-rate Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Now be grateful! I'm going to show you
the
first-rate way to spend New Year's!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come! I'm granting you the right to
make mochi
with me!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Uh... isn't that... a normal rice cooker?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. All mochi is is just balled up rice,
is it not?
Go on, take a handful and
press it together.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
But... this is just how you make rice
balls...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hey! What are the two of you doing
taking up the
whole kotatsu?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Move over! Make room for me, otherwise
forfeit
your oranges!

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey! Don't be a meanie!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! I'm not being mean—I'm being
King!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's always fun spending time with King.
She's so
cheerful and full of confidence.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's why we decided to repay King for
all she's
done for us by helping her out
this year.

text_block_list.name: Bob-cut Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
This is the most important year for King.
It will be
the year she makes her dreams
come true.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, the New Year's food has
arrived! It's
time to eat and plan for the
coming year!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's this? You can look at me like
that all you
want. I'm still charging you
for your portion of the
food.
choice_data_list: Let's make this an unforgettable year.
Let's make this an important year, okay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, the four of us enjoy our New
Year's meal
together.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Mmm... That was delicious. You ought to
be
praising me for having made a
reservation six
months in advance.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: But that aside, let's turn to the future.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
It may be a new year, by my plan
remains
unchanged. We proceed to the
Triple Crown tour.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Then, we force a certain someone to recognize me. You understand what I'm saying, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, very well. Let's start taking action
today.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
As a first-rate trainer, how do you plan
to train
this first-rate Umamusume?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Huh? You're one to talk!
choice_data_list: First, become an Umamusume who doesn't gain New Year's weight.
Become an Umamusume who values rest
To become an Umamusume loved by all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: You've eaten just as much as I have.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Come on, show me that belly of yours! I
look
perfect by comparison!

text_block_list.name: Cat-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! King! You actually pulled up your
trainer's
shirt!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! Well, I'm not the one who
brought up
weight management! Trainer,
expect me to
readjust your lifestyle
habits from here on!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Since then, King Halo has become the
one
training me.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Wow, that's a surprisingly reasonable
thing to
say.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Well, it would be awful for me to get sick before an important race. I have to be in perfect condition at all times.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Especially in winter. I can't afford to
catch a cold.
Hmm...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I've been taking in enough
vitamin C. I
should probably eat some
oranges.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We go on to have oranges for dessert
and enjoy a
leisurely New Year's holiday.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: What?! That's not a goal at all!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'm already loved and adored by
everyone, and
excessively so! What are
you even talking about?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
What's with that face? Do you mean to
insinuate
something?

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Explain yourself, Trainer. And make it
short.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She continues to pester me on the
subject for
some time.
